notes:
Summary: HydraFlow AgentWorks is a mid‑enterprise CCaaS vendor building a hybrid agent assist product (web chat + voice). They want streaming, low‑latency real‑time suggestions that appear inline for live agents, plus automatic ticket summarization post‑call and function/tool calls to update CRM and trigger workflows.

Requirements & constraints: - Latency SLO: p95 suggestion render <= 120ms (ideal 50–80ms) for typing/voice turn-end. - Throughput: baseline 100 concurrent agents, must handle spikes to 500+ during promotions. - Must support streaming token-level suggestions (partial completions) and deterministic guardrails for compliance (deny or redact PII in LLM outputs). - Tool calling: call external internal APIs (ticket create/update, escalate) via function calls with safe sandboxing. - Observability: token-level cost/latency breakdowns per route, per model, and per agent. - Deployment: prefer Dedicated for predictable latency; must be able to run Private (VPC/on‑prem) for regulated enterprise customers. - Security: SSO (SAML/Okta), audit logs, KMS integration for keys, retention policies, data residency in EU for some customers.

What they told us (paraphrases / quotes): - "We need suggestions that don't slow agents down — half a second is too long." — Jonas Kaur, Head of CX. - "If the model suggests anything with financial data we must redact and/or block it automatically." — Mara Lin, CTO. - "Function calls should be auditable; we can't have silent writes without a signature." — Platform PM.

POC details proposed: - 2-week live pilot on Redwood Dedicated with 100 concurrent agents, 2 model variants (quantized low‑latency and higher quality fallback). - Integration points: web app websocket for streaming suggestions, webhook for function-call events, Genesys/Five9 voice connector for turn detection. - Success criteria: suggestion p95 <= 120ms, 99.9% availability during business hours, false positive guardrail <= 2% on redaction decisions, ticket summarization F1 >= 0.78 on internal eval set.

Action items & next steps: - SE Priya to provision Dedicated pilot and share config template (batching, kv cache settings) by 2026-03-15. - Tech kickoff with HydraFlow infra (Five9 team) week of 2026-03-20. - Legal to reconcile EULA redlines; Ethan to escalate to sales ops for fast-track.

Open risks / blockers: - SOC2 attestation for on‑prem bundle currently pending; may push production start into Q3. - Voice provider (Five9) requires connector changes; dev time estimate ~2 weeks. - Budget commit needs VP approval; tied to Q2 planning.
